who-this-is-for.text: A joiner with a wallet on a public node who wants to run the three positive naming lifecycles against one persistent deployment, without reserving the devnet fixture pools.

what-you-can-do.text: Point the three runners at a deployment manifest. Each funds only its own positive actors from the live protocol parameters, evaluates every transaction with the node before signing, and stops with a named requirement before spending when the wallet is short or the spelling is taken. The sequence diagram shows the preflight, the funded submit, and the two stop-before-spending branches.

what-you-see-when-it-is-refused.text: Five named refusals: short wallet, already-claimed spelling, aggregate execution over the live limit, evaluated fee that does not fit the change minimum, and incomplete node evaluation. No refusal probe is submitted on the public path.

the-three-lifecycles.text: Register claims one exact spelling, recovery claims rc-main and maintains it, retirement claims rt-over and completes it permissionlessly into Over. The flowchart shows funding, evaluation, submission, and the two refusal branches.

funding-rule.text: Deposits, minimum change, collateral, and one maximum-size fee allowance all derive from the live parameters. Request funding never selects reference scripts, multi-asset outputs, or inputs reserved for later steps.

acceptance-from-the-shipped-pr-body.text: Docs checks green, three runners rebuilt with 109 passing cage tests, the lifecycle attach check green with the full suite retained, and read-only preprod allowance plans against a spendable balance. No public transaction was submitted by this change.

deviations.text: No dedicated issue exists; the mandate is the pull request body plus the operator's funding ruling. Two related tickets are referenced but not closed. The retroactive audit passed with one documented residual and no user-visible disagreement, so no question was raised.

limits-of-this-slice.text: Public journey acceptance stays pending until all three lifecycles run against preprod. The previous release predates this repair. No validator, Lean, workflow, or check-setting changes are included.
